messages:
ava: Heads up  I found a regression hitting latency when older agents don't do the new coalescer handshake. Short requests get pulled into big windows.
sam: Can you paste a minimal repro?
ava: Sure: tenant A, short input, agent without `coalesce_handshake` header. Server treats deadline_hint as absent and batches into default 100ms window -> p99 blows out.
zhen: That matches a lab run I did. If deadline_hint is missing we currently skip KV reservation and also end up waiting for larger coalesce windows.
ravi: Two immediate fixes: (1) synthesize a conservative deadline_hint at the gateway when header missing, (2) mark synthesized requests as "no-kv-reserve" to avoid headroom accounting.
marta: For (1) what's the right conservative value? Tenant-config min SLO or a fixed 50ms? We should avoid being so aggressive we hurt throughput.
ava: Proposal: pick min(tenant_min_slo, 75ms) as synth value. Keeps most short requests safe.
sam: For (2) I worry that marking no-kv-reserve will reduce cache hits and increase backend CPU. But it's probably safer than overcommitting KV. We should document the tradeoff.
zhen: Implementation note: do this at front-door normalize step. Normalize proto should emit fields: canonical_deadline_hint, kv_reserved(bool), handshake_source(enum). Downstream code reads canonical fields.
ravi: Agree on a normalization middleware. It prevents proliferating conditional checks in schedulers and aggregators. Keep it fast and optional to inline in hotpath.
marta: Telemetry: new counters `enqueue.normalized`, `enqueue.synth_deadline`, `enqueue.kv_no_reserve`. Also histograms for enqueue->start latency split by handshake_source.
ava: Rollout strategy: start with read-only normalization (emit metrics only) for 24h, watch percent of synthesized. If <1% do nothing. If >1% enable synth path per tenant with a gradual ramp.
sam: Also add an auto-compat rule: if a tenant has >5% synthesized for 30m, temporarily enable microwindows for them (smaller coalesce windows) for 10m. That protects SLOs while we notify them.
zhen: Tests: unit for normalize logic + an integ perf job that simulates 50k req/s with 10% legacy agents to validate no-kv-reserve avoids headroom overcommit.
ravi: Concern: synthesized deadline + no-kv-reserve could create a class of requests that get lower QoS but still expect low latency. We should include a response header `x-inference-compat: synthesized_deadline` so client teams can see it.
marta: Good idea. Also notify SMs via tenant-metrics alert when synthesized fraction spikes.
ava: Operational note: do not change mandatory fields in the Enqueue proto. Anything requiring agent rebuild is a non-starter. Use optional headers and server-side synth.
sam: Long-term: once agents are updated, collapse handshake into a single boolean header and remove synthesizer. But keep normalize layer as canonicalizer for future changes.
zhen: infra-bot: triggered job eng-runtime/compat-smoke (unit+light perf). :robot_face:
ava: I'll open the PR for the front-door normalizer and the telemetry.
ravi: I'll add KV headroom tests and the integ perf harness.
marta: I'll draft the rollout playbook and the tenant alert rules.
sam: I'll add the microwindow config flag and the auto-toggle hook.
ava: Great. We'll sync next eng-runtime checkin to confirm perf numbers. :thumbsup:
